name: After recital 7
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1938 as regards the role of gas storage for securing gas supplies ahead of the winter season
part_text: (7 b) In the event that a Member State deviates significantly and sustainably from the filling plan, it may inform the Commission of the measures taken, without any obligation to comply. The Commission would acknowledge receipt and could make a non-binding recommendation, taking into account in particular any adverse market conditions and the specific characteristics of the Member States.
